summary: Backend engineer with 3.6 years designing distributed systems and event-driven infrastructure with a strong platform engineering streak. Expertise in Go, AWS, and scaling microservices to 500K+ users.

bullets.text: Orchestrated full EC2 to ECS Fargate migration using Terraform, cutting infra management overhead by 40% and deployment time by 50%.
Re-architected async processing with AWS SQS FIFO & Standard queues, achieving near-zero message loss and 30% reduction in incidents.
Led R&D for a distributed video scoring platform, productionizing via SQS-driven pipeline and increasing throughput 8x.
Rebuilt KYC platform with pluggable verification vendors, reducing vendor onboarding time by 60% and document rollout by 70%.
Architected parallel AI transcription pipeline using Sarvam AI and concurrent worker pools, reducing turnaround time by 45%.
Re-architected invoice reconciliation as a Kafka-driven concurrent Go service, maintaining <15% CPU under peak load.
Scaled event-driven Node.js services to support 500K+ users across web and mobile with high availability.
Integrated 180+ city carrier APIs enabling 30-minute hyperlocal delivery SLA for 15,000+ daily shipments.
Redesigned reporting pipeline using SQL, Elasticsearch, and Snowflake, reducing generation time by 80%.
